If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in mid-horizon (days 10–20) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) over last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (days 1–5) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply from positive to negative within 3 days, reduce forecast by 2–3% in late horizon (days 20–30) to reflect sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending downward, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias in mid-horizon to align with momentum.  
If sentiment is neutral and price is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias in early horizon to capture momentum.  
If sentiment is mixed (alternating ±0.33) over last 3 days, apply 1% smoothing correction to forecast path to dampen volatility.
